name: Frankenstein
equipment: A copy of the book (public domain -- free from Project Gutenberg or Standard Ebooks)
instructions: Frankenstein was written by Mary Shelley, first published in 1818.
Victor Frankenstein creates life in his laboratory, only to abandon his creation -- often credited as one of the first true science fiction novels, written when Shelley was just 18.
Discussion prompt: Ambition is one of the novel's central threads -- note a passage where you saw it most clearly.
